The migrated file is at `out/module.ts`. Type checking passes, results match the original on 50,000 randomized inputs from your ranges and on your example inputs, and the bundle is 1521 bytes (min+gzip), down from 9874. No lodash import remains.

The loaded skill text was generic migration advice with no es-toolkit specifics, so I worked out the mappings from the installed es-toolkit 1.53.2 source and tests.

| Original (lodash) | Migrated | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `words` | `words` from `es-toolkit/compat` | The main-entry `words` splits `4th` into `4`, `th`, which differs from lodash. The compat version matched on every sample. |
| `groupBy(rows, 'age')` | `groupBy(rows, (row) => row.age)` from `es-toolkit` | Small adapter for the property-name shorthand. The main-entry version matched lodash on every sample. |
| `isEmpty` | `isEmpty` from `es-toolkit/compat` | Only exported from the compat entry. It matched lodash on every sample. |

I considered importing all three from `es-toolkit/compat`, but that gave 3994 bytes, because the compat `groupBy` is much heavier. The mixed version is the smallest I found that still matches lodash.

Own code in the bundle is 90 bytes, down from 169. I did not install anything. The only file written is `out/module.ts`; the scratch variants and test scripts were removed or kept in the scratchpad.
